hero.title: Realtime worlds, still frames, and the odd website.
hero.text: I build environments, systems, and visuals in Unreal — and whatever else the brief needs. Spare time is theoretical; the work is not.

about: I'm a Unreal Engine developer and 3D generalist. I like to make pretty things that run smooth. I'm mostly interested in realtime visualization, VR and technical stuff. I also dabble in graphics and web, and in my free time I like to take photos on my trips.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.lede: AI is everywhere — so here's how I actually use it.
ai.text: I use AI every day, and I also hate it — especially when it replaces creative thinking and authenticity. I put it on the boring, time-consuming work I don’t want, so I get more time for the creative stuff I’m good at. New tech is the fun part: I push AI past chatbot defaults and into the edge of realtime pipelines.

items.title: Speed the dull
items.text: Automate glue, cleanup, and other chores I’d rather not do — so creative hours stay creative.

items.title: Keep the craft
items.text: No outsourcing taste. If it starts standing in for thinking or authenticity, I’m out.

items.title: Ride the edge
items.text: I like new tech. I wire models into tooling and Unreal workflows — not just another chat window.
